latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Baroque Art Generator.

- Transforms any subject into dramatic baroque-style oil paintings with rich chiaroscuro lighting and classical Renaissance composition.
- Supports style options inspired by Caravaggio and Rembrandt.
- Allows size customization (`portrait`, `landscape`, `square`, `tall`) and style inheritance via reference image.
- Designed for art collectors, Etsy sellers, and lovers of classical aesthetics.
- Requires a free Neta AI API token for image generation.
